A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional parts
skills.definition: Make fractional parts directly comparable before subtraction by finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number as a fraction with denominator 0 over the needed unit.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form such as a + 0/b so the fractional parts can be subtracted.
Tag when the step explicitly prepares unlike or missing fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting/conversion is performed.
Do not tag pure subtraction steps after the fractions are already aligned.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number; that belongs to a different skill.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step converts a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or rewrites an improper fraction part by carrying 1 or more wholes into the whole-number part.
Tag this preparation step whether the normalized number is the minuend or subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction; borrowing is a later regrouping step, not normalization.
Do not tag combining the final whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract without borrowing
skills.definition: Subtract aligned fractions and/or whole-number parts directly when no regrouping from the whole part is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like fractions directly.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts directly and the fractional result is nonnegative.
Tag when the item is completed without any borrowing/regrouping step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator or rewrite a whole number as 0/b.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag cases where the fractional subtraction is negative and the solver must borrow from the whole part.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part is too small to subtract, then reduce or express the result in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to b/b or equivalent fractional units.
Tag when subtraction continues after borrowing to obtain the final fractional part.
Tag when the solution simplifies a resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms as part of finishing the problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction cases with no regrouping and no simplification step shown.
Do not tag common-denominator setup or rewriting a whole as 0/b before any borrowing occurs.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts comparable by finding a common denominator and rewriting equivalent fractions when the given denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step rewrites one or both fractions into equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator alignment with an existing denominator.
Do not tag borrowing steps; those belong to regrouping.

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a usable subtraction form, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form such as 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8 to support part-by-part subtraction.
Tag when the step prepares unlike representations so whole and fractional parts can be subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between fractions; that belongs to equalizing fraction units.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole or fractional parts after the rewrite.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.

skills.name: Subtract corresponding parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when a step combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the final unsimplified or simplified result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting, normalization, or common-denominator finding.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag reduction of a fraction to lowest terms unless subtraction is also performed in that same step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve a negative or reducible fractional result by borrowing from the whole part and/or reducing the final fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a step simplifies 0 over a denominator to 0 or combines a zero fractional part into a whole number result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag routine subtraction when no borrowing or simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that belongs to normalizing mixed forms.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts directly comparable by finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number as a fraction with the needed denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a stated denominator to align with a fractional part.
Tag when the step explicitly prepares fraction parts so they can be subtracted in the same units.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting/alignment is performed.
Do not tag pure normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3 unless a denominator-alignment rewrite is also shown.
Do not tag the actual subtraction after the fractions are already aligned.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the solution explicitly states normalize the mixed number or equivalent wording before subtraction.
Tag when the rewrite changes the whole part and fractional part but preserves the value.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators for like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers or mixed/whole combinations without borrowing.
Tag when the step produces a zero fractional part or zero whole result through direct subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory conversion to common denominators or rewriting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification of the final result.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: When direct subtraction gives a negative fractional part, borrow 1 from the whole part and then simplify or express the final result in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts that 1 into denominator-over-denominator form.
Tag when the regrouped fraction is then used to complete the subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction or converts a zero fraction such as 0/3 to 0 or 1 + 0/8 to 1 as part of finalizing the answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include simplification.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion or normalization steps.
Do not tag mere combination of already-computed whole and fractional parts unless simplification/regrouping is also present.
